profile.headline: AZ-900|A+| Network+ Cloud Computing
profile.summary: Detail-oriented web developer leveraging experience as a game server administrator to creatively solve problems. Two year track record of successfully debugging other individual’s code, resulting in continuous recommendation of assistance to other developers. Competent in full-stack development, embracing both front-end and back-end technologies. Self-starter who takes initiative to learn new technologies with a history of self taught proficiency in HTML, LUA, and Python.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
⦁ Managed installation, configuration, and administration of production systems across multi-site environments (on-premises and Azure).
⦁ Provided 24/7 on-call support for Linux, Windows servers, and network infrastructure.
⦁ Administered Linux systems in both test and production environments.
⦁ Developed tools for process monitoring and data collection.
⦁ Designed, implemented, and managed complex local and wide-area networks.
⦁ Implemented disaster recovery plans, maintained patch levels, and performed performance tuning.
⦁ Responded to emergencies, led troubleshooting efforts, and implemented remediation plans.
⦁ Analyzed, recommended, and coordinated equipment purchases.
⦁ Supported Windows Servers and Active Directory services.
⦁ Automated common server tasks through script development.
positions.insights: Desktop Computers, Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and +10 skills

positions.title: Base Security Computer Operator
positions.description:
⦁	Controlled access of visitors and military members for naval base.
⦁	Answered phones and registered military ID cards. 
⦁	Processed passes and collected forms for background checks.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
⦁ Developed and implemented a comprehensive risk management plan, proactively mitigating potential risks and ensuring project success. 
⦁ Conducted rigorous safety inspections and verification processes to ensure compliance with regulatory standards, enabling safe initiation of schedule maintenance and repairs.
⦁ Fostered collaboration among diverse stakeholders, including technical teams, executives, and clients, aligning the project with strategic objectives.
⦁ Implemented proactive problem-solving strategies that reduced project delays by 40%, ensuring timely project completion.
positions.insights: Teamwork, Attention to Detail and +1 skill

positions.title: Interior Communications Electrician
positions.description:
⦁ Performed organizational and intermediate maintenance on a variety of shipboard systems, ensuring smooth operation and system uptime.
⦁ Analyzed system malfunctions through inspection, testing, and casualty analysis, pinpointing root causes and developing effective repair plans.
⦁ Repaired electrical, electronic, fiber optic, hydraulic, mechanical, and synchro/servo systems, ensuring adherence to safety protocols.
⦁ Interpreted and utilized blueprints and system interface diagrams for troubleshooting, repair, and preventive maintenance tasks.
⦁ Coordinated maintenance activities with team members, ensuring efficient completion and minimal downtime for critical systems.
⦁ Maintained and updated technical documentation, including casualty analysis reports and system maintenance records.
positions.insights: Teamwork, Attention to Detail and +4 skills
